entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return some shoes.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your order number?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloPro Spin Class Shoes, delivered on January 9th. To get this started for you, could I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. I wore them for one ride and got terrible blisters. They're just not the right cycling shoes for my feet.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, especially when you're clipping in with new cleats. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers.
Right. So, can I get a refund or not?
Yes, absolutely. Since the shoes were delivered just two days ago, you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can process a full refund for you immediately.

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now that contains a prepaid shipping label. Simply pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any carrier location.
Got the email. So as soon as you get them back, the refund is processed?
That's correct. Once our warehouse scans the return, the refund will be issued back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
